text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
The silhouettes of a boy and a woman stand by a shrine that
leads to the Tower of Luna.
The woman reaches out a hand toward the boy's head—
text_block_list.orig_text:
ルナの塔へとつながる祠の前に立つ、男女のシルエット。
女性の片手が、男性の頭へと伸びていく──

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
You've done well walking all this way. We've really come quite far.
You're such a good boy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここまで遠かったけど、
よく頑張って歩けましたね。
いい子いい子～

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
That aside, what a mysterious place this is.
Even the plants here look different to the ones in the Elven Village.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それにしても、
なんだか不思議な場所ね。
ここにいる植物さんたちも、
エルフの里の子たちとは全然違うわ～

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Oh my. Who could that be in a place like this?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら？　
こんなところに誰かしら？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Ahhh! That tickles!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ～ん！　
くすぐった～い！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
...Oh! {0}, perfect timing!
A leaf got stuck inside my shirt... Could you get it out for me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あ！　
{0}君、
ちょうどいいところに！
葉っぱが服の中に入っちゃって……
取ってくれる？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! Not there!
I think it went a little farther down.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんっ！　
そこじゃないわ～
もう少し奥に入っていったみたいなの。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Goodness, your hand is tickling me too! I can't stand it!
Get it out already!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それに、
君の手もくすぐったくて仕方ないわ！
早く取って～！

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
My, my.
What are you two doing? We're in the middle of the forest in broad
daylight...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらあらあら～
お天気のいい日に、
こんな森の中で～

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness! I think you got it. You're a lifesaver!
...By the way, what are you doing here?
And who might this be?
text_block_list.orig_text:
よかった～
取れたみたいだね。
ありがとう！
……
それより
どうしてこんなところにいるの？
そちらの方は？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Pleased to meet you. I'm Misato, a nursery teacher from the Elven
Village. We heard that we can find clues here about regaining his
memory, so we came here while out on a stroll.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はじめまして、
私は
エルフの里で保育士をしているミサトです。
ここに
彼の記憶を取り戻す手がかりがあると聞いて、
お散歩のついでに来たんです～

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that so?
I didn't know this place was so special...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら
そうなんですね！
ここがそんな場所だったなんて……

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
I'm Io. I teach at Lucent Academy.
I'm {0}'s homeroom teacher.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私は
ルーセント学院で教師をしているイオです。
{0}君の担任なんです。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
I'm out here searching for a place to give my extracurricular classes.
It's a bit embarrassing to admit, but I got kind of lost...
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日は、
課外学習で来られそうな場所を探していたんです。
恥ずかしいんですけど、
ここには
途中で道に迷ってたまたま……

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
This edifice looks exceptionally old.
It would be the perfect place for a history lesson.
Miss Misato, would you mind if I tag along?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだか
とっても古そうな建物みたいだし、
歴史の授業にぴったりかも。
ミサト先生、
私もついて行ってもいいですか？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
But not only for that reason. If it's for {0}'s sake,
then as his teacher, I want to do as much as I can to help...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それだけじゃなくて、
{0}君のためになるなら、
先生として
私もなにか手伝ってあげたいから……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
The more the merrier.
I'm sure {0} finds it heartening to have
two teachers guiding him.
text_block_list.orig_text:
もちろんですよ～
{0}君も
引率の先生が二人になって
心強いはずです。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
...? Come to think of it, Miss Misato, you're a nursery teacher, right? 
Then how did you come to be {0}'s teacher too?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……？　
先生が二人って、
ミサト先生は保育士さんですよね？
どうして{0}君の先生なんですか？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking after him along with the other children at the village nursery
school. Since he's the eldest, he's a very good boy, and he doesn't
cause any trouble!
text_block_list.orig_text:
里の保育園で、
他の子どもたちと一緒に
お世話をしてるんですよ～
一番お兄さんだから、
あんまり手がかからなくて
とってもいい子なんです～

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You're going to preschool, too?
{0}, how old are you again?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ？　
保育園にも通ってるの？
{0}君、
今いくつだったっけ？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Well now, instead of standing around idly chatting, let's get going.
choice_data_list: It's a dangerous place, so be careful.
text_block_list.orig_text:
さあ
立ち話はここまでにして、
先に進みましょう～

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
{0}, you don't have anything to worry about.
Come. Miss Io, shall we?
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}君はなんにも心配しなくていいのよ。
さあ
イオ先生も行きましょう～

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Huuuh?! Wait up, you two!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ～！？　
二人とも待って～！
